# Backlog

## Stories

- As a seller, I want to see my remaining stock for each listing, so that I do not promise stock I do not have.
- As a rider, I want to be paid a waiting fee after 10 minutes at a pickup, so that waiting time is not unpaid.
- As an auditor, I want each change record to show the approver and the approval time, so that I can verify who signed off.
- As a buyer, I want to see the total price including delivery for two offers side by side, so that I can compare them before committing.
- As a small shop owner, I want to accept contactless card payments, so that I do not need to buy a terminal.
